market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins has won five consecutive terms in Maine, consistently outperforming the state’s slight Democratic lean. She won re-election in 2020 by 9 points even as Joe Biden carried the state, and she survived the 2008 Obama wave. If she runs in 2026, her incumbency and personal brand make her a strong favourite. Even with some probability of retirement, the true odds of a Republican win are around 75%, far above the market's 22.5%.
evidence_points: Collins won in 2020 with 51% of the vote, overperforming Trump by 18 points.
Maine has a Cook PVI of D+2, yet Collins has won in both midterm and presidential cycles by solid margins.
No credible retirement announcement or primary threat suggests she will run, and open primaries favour her cross-party appeal.
